description: This file defines the CommonEncryptionData class used for parsing and managing encryption key data, including handling of PSSH boxes, XML, and JSON init data, within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData
classes.description: Class for parsing and managing common encryption data, including key IDs and support for multiple encryption systems.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData::KeyId
classes.description: Represents a key identifier with associated system flags, extending OCDM::KeyId.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::CommonEncryptionData
methods.description: Constructor that parses encryption data from a byte array.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::AddKeyId
methods.description: Adds or updates a key ID in the internal list.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::UpdateKeyStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific key ID.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current keys support another set of keys.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Parse
methods.description: Parses the input data to extract encryption information, including PSSH boxes and XML/JSON data.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParsePSSHBox
methods.description: Parses a PSSH box to extract key IDs based on system type.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParseXMLBox
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract key IDs, supporting different header formats.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParseJSONInitData
methods.description: Parses JSON formatted init data to extract key IDs.
